mapper.select: select r.review_id,r.order_id,r.service_id,s.service_name,r.user_id,r.user_info,r.rating,r.content,r.reply_content,r.reply_status,r.status,r.create_time from zjudg_service_review r left join zjudg_service s on s.service_id=r.service_id where r.review_id=#{id}

select r.review_id,r.order_id,r.service_id,s.service_name,r.user_id,r.user_info,r.rating,r.content,r.reply_content,r.reply_status,r.status,r.create_time from zjudg_service_review r left join zjudg_service s on s.service_id=r.service_id where r.order_id=#{orderId} limit 1
mapper.delete: delete from zjudg_service_review where review_id in #{id}
